Vessels

Our autonomous surface vessels combine best-in-class hardware, software, and artificial intelligence to accomplish the nation's most critical maritime missions.

Corsair

Description

Corsair

Corsair is a 24' Autonomous Surface Vessel (ASV) capable of carrying up to 1,000 lbs over 1,000 NM. Corsair stands ready to deliver multi-mission capabilities rapidly and at scale around the world.

Specifications
Range
1,000+ nm
1,000+ nm
Top Speed
35+ kts
35+ kts
Payload
1,000 lbs
1,000 lbs

Mirage

Description

Mirage

Mirage is a 52' Autonomous Surface Vessel (ASV) that can provide diverse capabilities across a range of maritime operations. With 2,500 NM of range and 3,500 lbs of payload capacity, Mirage is poised to serve as a force multiplier for manned and unmanned teams in every ocean.

Specifications
Range
2,500+ nm
2,500+ nm
Top Speed
35+ kts
35+ kts
Payload
3,500 lbs
3,500 lbs

Marauder

Description

Marauder

Marauder is a 180' Autonomous Surface Vessel (ASV) designed to host and deliver significant capabilities across complex maritime environments. Capable of carrying up to 150MT in four 40' ISO containers, eight 20' ISO containers, or other modular payload configurations, Marauder is Saronic's premier platform for logistics and at-sea payload deployment.

Specifications
Range
5,400 nm
Base Load (25 MT)
4,100 nm
Max Load (150 MT)
Speed
12 kts
Cruise
25+ kts
Sprint
Max Payload
150 MT
150 MT
01Hardware

Pushing the limits of innovation, performance, and reliability.

H/001

Durable

Engineered to endure the rigors of complex operations in the maritime environment.

H/002

Configurable & Modular

Flexible architecture to seamlessly integrate a variety of mission-specific payloads and sensors.

H/003

Networked

Resilient multichannel communications for manned and unmanned teaming, including optional configurations for contested environments.

H/004

Attritable

Produced at scale for mass deployment and utilization in high risk missions.

02Software

Harnessing the power of AI for superhuman results.

S/001

Mission-Level Autonomy

Artificial intelligence and cross-platform data fusion enable multi-asset teaming.

S/002

Mission Control

Browser based interface that can operate independently or integrate into any operating software.

S/003

Smart Navigation

Adaptive path planning for optimized performance in a variety of different sea states.

S/004

Simulation

Digital twins accelerate learning and reduce risk prior to system validation in the physical world.

More

ECHELON
ADVANCED
COMMAND-AND-CONTROL
SOFTWARE
ADVANCED COMMAND-AND-CONTROL SOFTWARE

Autonomy unlocked.

Echelon is built to command the most advanced autonomous fleets on the water. By tightly integrating software and hardware, it avoids the compromises of bolt-on C2—delivering faster decisions, smarter behaviors, and mission-specific control at scale.

Purpose-Built Interface

Access the full fidelity of Saronic's proprietary autonomy through a custom-tuned UI.

Native Behavior Control

Unlock differentiated autonomy behaviors not possible with third-party systems.

Optimized for Reality

Mission planning and C2 logic matched to real-world vessel performance.

Integrated by Design

End-to-end architecture reduces friction, cuts latency, and boosts reliability.

Built for Evolution

Engineered to enable multi-asset learning, edge AI, and collaborative behaviors.

Informed in Real-Time

Live telemetry and autonomy-aware alerts keep operators focused on what matters.

1 / 3Plan

Set mission objectives, routes, and roles with coordinated precision.

P/001

Click-to-Plan Interface

Rapidly define complex missions through an intuitive, interactive UI.

P/002

Precision Tasking Control

Task individual vessels or multi-asset teams with roles, timing, and constraints for synchronized execution.

P/003

Contextual Mission Data

Use overlays like bathymetry and traffic lanes to inform real-time planning.

2 / 3Simulate

Run mission scenarios to validate performance before real deployment.

S/001

Pre-Deployment Confidence

Validate missions ahead of time to reduce risk and build operator trust.

S/002

Transparent Autonomy Logic

Observe decision-making across varied scenarios for full operational legibility.

S/003

Real-Time Adjustments

Edit routes, timing, and behaviors on the fly—no restart required.

3 / 3Execute

Command and monitor vessels live with full operational control.

E/001

Live Mission Feeds

Real-time video and telemetry deliver full situational awareness across the mission area.

E/002

Smart Alerting System

Highlights critical autonomy decisions—filtering signal from noise.

E/003

Simulation-to-Live Sync

Seamlessly move from test to live execution with zero mission degradation.

More
